description: This file defines an asynchronous utility function 'importFreshModule' that dynamically imports a module from a specified URL, using 'import()' with a URL constructed from a base URL and a specifier. It supports module importation with specific handling for Vitest's URL-based module instances.

methods.name: export async function importFreshModule<TModule>( importFreshModule
methods.description: Asynchronously imports a module from a constructed URL and returns it as a generic type.
